scripts.dev: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @svara/api build && concurrently --kill-others --names packages,web,api,worker "pnpm --filter=./packages/** -r --parallel --if-present dev" "pnpm --filter @svara/web dev" "pnpm --filter @svara/api dev" "pnpm --filter @svara/worker dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: tsx scripts/database.ts test && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:integration:container: docker compose --env-file .env.compose -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.demo.yaml exec -T api node --import tsx scripts/database.ts test && docker compose --env-file .env.compose -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.demo.yaml exec -T api node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:container: docker run --rm --network none svara-app:local node tests/runtime/preview-guard.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm build
